title: Transforming Legacy Systems in Smart Manufacturing
shortChallenge: The client’s outdated automation platform lacked real-time monitoring and caused excessive downtime and inefficiencies.
shortSolution: ABC Company built a scalable IoT-enabled system with predictive maintenance and real-time analytics dashboards, reducing downtime and improving throughput by enabling data-driven decisions.
challenge:
The client, a mid-sized manufacturer of precision parts, ran its production lines on an automation platform installed more than fifteen years ago. Machines reported only basic on/off signals, so supervisors had no live view of speed, temperature or vibration on the lines.

Problems were found only when a machine stopped. Unplanned downtime cost several hours a week, spare parts were ordered in a rush, and planners could not say with confidence when an order would be finished. Replacing every machine at once was not an option: it would have stopped production for months.
solution:
ABC Company connected the existing machines instead of replacing them. Small IoT gateways read the sensors already inside each machine and added new ones where needed, then sent the data to a secure cloud platform.

On top of this data we built real-time dashboards for the shop floor and the planning team, and predictive maintenance models that warn days in advance when a part is wearing out. Maintenance moved from reacting to breakdowns to planned work in quiet hours. The rollout was done line by line, so production never had to stop, and downtime and rush orders dropped sharply in the first year.
